Hero.title: Careful counsel. <highlight>Uncompromising</highlight> defence.
Hero.description: A Nepali law firm built on quiet diligence rather than loud promises — standing beside families, founders and enterprises when the stakes are highest, and the law is anything but simple.

Info.title: A quiet legacy of <highlight>trust</highlight> and defence.
Info.p1: We began in a two-room office in Putalisadak in 1998, taking on cases nobody else wanted to touch. Twenty-five years later, our doors are wider — but the instinct is the same. We work carefully, we say what we mean, and we do not take a matter we cannot honestly serve.
Info.p2: Our advocates appear regularly before the Supreme Court and the High Courts across Nepal, and advise clients from single-founder startups to listed companies. Every engagement is led by a partner. Not a "team". A person, whose name you will know.
Info.p3: We are proud of the work. We are prouder of the clients who keep coming back — often years apart, with a very different problem, but the same one question: what would you do, if this were you?
